article_title: Orangutans released back into Borneo forest after devastating fires

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Indonesia is building a new zoo for orangutans.
Eight rescued orangutans were released into a suitable Borneo forest reserve after wildfires destroyed or threatened their habitats.
Scientists discovered a new orangutan species in Sumatra.
Plantation owners moved their cattle away from forest fires.
tasks.correct_answer: Eight rescued orangutans were released into a suitable Borneo forest reserve after wildfires destroyed or threatened their habitats.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת את שחרורם של שמונה אורנגאוטנים שניצלו משריפות, לאחר שנמצא עבורם אזור טבעי מתאים ובטוח.

tasks.prompt: Which animals were among the eight orangutans released on Friday?
options: Three mothers, their three daughters and two adult males
Eight adult males from one plantation
Four mothers and four newborn babies
Two mothers, two daughters and four adult females
tasks.correct_answer: Three mothers, their three daughters and two adult males
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה שוחררו שלוש אימהות, שלוש בנותיהן ושני זכרים בוגרים.

tasks.prompt: What does “incinerated” mean in the sentence about the forestry around Mama Nopi?
options: Protected by conservation workers
Changed into farmland slowly
Completely burned by fire
Covered by flood water
tasks.explanation_hebrew: incinerated פירושו נשרף כליל; השריפות השמידו את היער שסביב האורנגאוטנים.

tasks.prompt: Why was the release reserve selected?
options: It was close to a large city.
It contained only plantation trees.
It had empty cages for all 46 rescued animals.
It had food and water and was connected to other forested areas.
tasks.correct_answer: It had food and water and was connected to other forested areas.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השמורה נבחרה משום שיש בה מזון ומים והיא מחוברת לאזורים מיוערים נוספים, דבר שמגדיל את סיכויי ההישרדות.

tasks.prompt: Why did fires force some orangutans closer to humans?
options: Rescuers trained them to visit villages.
The fires reduced food and safe forest routes, leaving the animals in or near plantations.
The orangutans preferred crops to natural food.
The reserve required them to cross a town.
tasks.correct_answer: The fires reduced food and safe forest routes, leaving the animals in or near plantations.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השריפות צמצמו את היער, המזון ונתיבי התנועה הבטוחים, ולכן האורנגאוטנים נותרו באזורים חקלאיים קרובים לבני אדם.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “volatile” mean when describing weather patterns?
options: Stable and easy to predict
Likely to change suddenly and become more extreme
Cooler in every season
Limited to coastal areas
tasks.correct_answer: Likely to change suddenly and become more extreme
tasks.explanation_hebrew: volatile מתאר דפוסים בלתי יציבים שעלולים להשתנות במהירות ולהיות קיצוניים יותר.

tasks.prompt: What happened to Mama Man and her baby before they were evacuated?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שהם נוטרו מאז יוני באזור מטעים ליד חלקת יער קטנה, שהאש צמצמה עוד יותר את מרחב התנועה ושסכנת החשיפה ללהבות הובילה לפינוי.
expected_points: Rescuers had monitored them since June.
They were living in a plantation area beside a small forest patch.
Nearby fires further restricted their roaming area and safe route to other forest.
They were evacuated in early September because of the threat from the blazes.

tasks.prompt: Summarise why the orangutans were rescued and why they were later moved to the reserve.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את השריפות ופגיעה בבית הגידול, מחסור במזון וקרבה לבני אדם, וכן את יתרונות השמורה שנבחרה.
expected_points: Wildfires burned and fragmented the orangutans' original habitats.
The damage limited food and safe movement and pushed some animals toward plantations and people.
The animals were rescued when remaining in those areas became unsafe.
The new reserve offers food, water and links to other forests, giving them a better chance to survive naturally.

tasks.prompt: How can plantation development make wildfire damage more serious for orangutans?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין פינוי יער למטעים, החלפת יער צפוף ועמיד יותר לצמחייה דלילה, פיצול בית הגידול והתפשטות אש קלה יותר.
expected_points: Land clearing replaces natural forest with plantation vegetation.
The article says natural forests are more fire-resistant than the less dense and shaded replacement vegetation.
Plantations fragment orangutan habitat and reduce safe routes between forest areas.
When fires spread, animals can lose food and become trapped near humans.

tasks.prompt: Write a short conservation update explaining the release without claiming that all danger has ended.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את מספר האורנגאוטנים, סיבת החילוץ, התאמת השמורה והמשך הסכנות משריפות, שינוי אקלים ופגיעה בבתי גידול.
expected_points: State that eight rescued orangutans were released into a Borneo reserve.
Explain that wildfires had made their former habitats unsafe.
Mention that the reserve has food, water and connections to other forests.
Acknowledge continuing threats from fires, climate change and habitat loss.
